newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius bourse falls on political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius bourse falls on political uncertainty.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index, Semdex lost 3.65 points to 382.32 on Friday, reflecting declines in some blue chips stocks, brokers said.
Turnover was posted at 11.63 million rupees on 561,231 shares from 21.35 million rupees on 941,625 shares on Wednesday.
"The falling of the Semdex appears to confirm the uncertain political climate that is prevailing in the country since the splitting up of Labour-MMM alliance government," a broker said.
In the banking sector, Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) eased 1.50 rupee to 88.50 rupees on 55,158 shares and State Bank of Mauritius fell 10 cents to 11.90 rupees on 223,950 shares.

Hotel based Sun Resorts gained 10 cents to 50.00 rupees on 21,100 shares, New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) lost 1.00 rupee to 37.00 rupees on 3,742 shares and Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) fell 60 cents to 49.10 rupees, but was unquoted.

In the commerce sector, conglomerate Rogers was 3.00 rupees lower to 97.00 rupees on 190 shares, Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) was stable at 16.20 rupees on 8,150 shares and Happy World Foods (HWF) lost 30 cents to 15.50 rupees on 6,198 shares.
Sugar based Harel Freres was unchanged to 55.00 rupees on 3,500 shares and Mon Desert Alma (MDA) (O) was stable at 88.00 rupees on 150 shares.
Investment stocks Fincorp was stable at 72.00 rupees on 1,922 shares and Policy was unchanged to 3.90 on 125,255 shares. Air Mauritius gained 20 cents to 38.60 rupees on 17,600 shares.
